svg_geometry.scope: Chromium axis-aligned glyph bounding-box overlap proxy across all SVG pages; pair area >1 CSS pixel squared. Bounding boxes are not glyph ink or a complete collision/engraving-quality assessment. Rest-notehead and rest-rest pairs only.

visual_review: Human-inspected before/after first pages of Brahms, Fishin and private derived 180-second input. Automatic geometry checks cover all 23 baseline and 30 new SVG pages; not a page-by-page human audit.
limits: Notation partitions are mechanical, not recovered instruments, hands or independently performed musical voices.
Only equal-onset/equal-duration unique pitches share a chord; independent and duplicate intervals remain.
Invisible spacer rests remain in MusicXML for timing; true staff silence has one visible rest stream.
Reduction previously hid true pauses as well; those pauses now display, so reduction visible-rest counts can increase.
More spacing can increase page count. No complete collision, accidental, ledger-line, tie/slur or human engraving-quality guarantee.
SVG bounding-box overlap is a limited geometric proxy, not ink intersection or a music readability rating.
Four reused public music recordings and two non-music controls have no independent note-level truth; private 180-second repeat is not an independent recording.
Transcription errors, default meter, global tempo and sixteenth-note quantization are unchanged.
Windows x64 CPU only; GPU, Demucs, Linux/macOS/ARM not newly validated.
AGPL, model non-commercial conditions and unresolved SA/ND conflict remain unchanged.
